title: Plants in China
subtitle: 考点：中国植物 / 描述特点 / province
passage: China has many beautiful and special plants. The peony is one of the most popular flowers in the country. Luoyang, a city in Henan Province, is famous for its peonies. Every spring, thousands of visitors go there to see the large pink, red and white flowers.
The lotus grows in water. Its leaves are big and round, and its flowers open in summer. Many Chinese poems and paintings are about lotus flowers. The lotus seeds and roots can also be eaten.

The ginkgo is a very old kind of tree. Its leaves are shaped like small fans, and they turn bright yellow in autumn. Some ginkgo trees in China are more than a thousand years old. Because ginkgos can live so long, people believe they bring good luck. We should protect these amazing plants.
